messages:
Ruth: publish blocked — regendiff flagged changes after regen. looks like param ordering noise in generated SDKs, and one flaky test that mutates retry defaults.
Cal: can you paste a tiny diff? hoping it's ordering-only.
Ruth: yep ordering-only. snippet:
```
- /items/{id}/get: parameters: [scope, id]
+ /items/{id}/get: parameters: [id, scope]
```
Mina: param order flip causes TS/Go parity checks to fail and changelog-generator to emit an "API changed" line.
regen-bot: job #99902 regendiff: 3 files changed (param-order), 1 file content drift (tests/retry-leak.spec.js). deterministic: false
Cal: short-term: add `--canonical-param-order` to regen CI and relax release-gate to ignore param-order-only diffs. long-term: canonicalize traversal in parse layer.
Mina: i'll patch the flaky test to sandbox retry config and add an afterEach restore. also adding a unit that runs regen 5x to assert stability.
Ruth: can you push CI hotfix now? publish window in ~1h.
Cal: pushed branch hotfix/regendiff-param-order; CI regen now includes `--canonical-param-order` and gate updated.
ci-bot: build #99903: regen step re-run -> PASSED (no regendiff)
Ruth: perfect. Mina, pls open PR with test fix & stability unit. i'll add an onboarding note: "If first-run regen shows param-order diffs, re-run with `--canonical-param-order` and file a ticket."
Mina: PR #210 opened: fixes test, adds regen stability unit, small changelog note.
regen-bot: PR scan: changelog entry present; semver impact: none.
Cal: created follow-up ticket DEX-2100 to upstream deterministic traversal.
ci-bot: build #99910: all sample-sdk jobs PASSED
Ruth: closing thread — thanks :party:
